name: Etobicoke
title: Home Renovations in Etobicoke | Muddy York Contracting
description: Etobicoke-based renovation contractor for basements, kitchens, bathrooms, decks and full main floors. See real local projects and book a free consultation.
lede: Etobicoke is home base. We're a small general contracting crew working on basements, kitchens, bathrooms, decks and full main floors across the neighbourhoods we live and work in.
body: A lot of Etobicoke houses are post-war bungalows and back-splits with closed-off kitchens and unfinished or dated basements. Opening up the main floor and finishing the basement are the jobs we're asked about most, and they're the jobs we've done most.
Every project starts the same way: a free walk-through where we talk through options, trade-offs and budget, then a detailed quote that lays out the knowns, the unknowns and the timeline.

name: West End Toronto
title: General Contractor in West End Toronto | Muddy York Contracting
description: Renovations in Junction Triangle, High Park, Bloor West Village, Runnymede and Roncesvalles. Real before-and-after projects from a west-end general contractor.
h1: General contractor for Toronto's west end
lede: Some of our longest-running work is in the west end: century homes in Junction Triangle, High Park and Bloor West Village where nothing is square and every wall has a story.
body: Older Toronto houses mean old plumbing stacks, plaster walls and tight footprints. We've re-accessed main stacks to fit powder rooms under stairs, rebuilt 100-year-old bathrooms around cast-iron tubs and opened up narrow main floors.
We quote the knowns and the unknowns up front, so the surprises in an old house don't turn into surprises on your bill.

name: Mississauga
title: Bathroom, Kitchen & Basement Renovations in Mississauga | Muddy York Contracting
description: Renovation contractor serving Mississauga from next door in Etobicoke: bathrooms, kitchens, basements and main floors with clear quotes and clean job sites.
lede: We're based just over the border in Etobicoke, so Mississauga is a short drive for us. Bathrooms, kitchens, basements and main-floor renovations, done by the same crew from start to finish.
body: Whether it's a dated washroom, a closed-in kitchen or a basement that's never been finished, the process is the same: a free consultation, a detailed quote with the knowns and unknowns spelled out, a clean site every day and a follow-up visit a week after we finish.
